fields.name: removed

fields.name: component

fields.name: buttonFlag

fields.name: y

fields.name: x
fields.comment: X screen pixel coord, clamped 0..0xFFFF when serialized

fields.name: timestampMs
fields.comment: jag::FrameTime::m_currentTimeMS at capture; delta encoded in packet

fields.name: plane
fields.comment: Map level 0..3 (masked &3). Low-res region/facing updates accumulate into this.

fields.name: mapSquareX
fields.comment: Low-res map-square X (regionX, 0..255 &0xff). World tileX = mapSquareX*64 + localX. X axis of the 8-dir/region deltas.

fields.name: mapSquareY
fields.comment: Low-res map-square Y (regionY, 0..255 &0xff). World tileY = mapSquareY*64 + localY. Y axis of the 8-dir/region deltas.

fields.name: processedThisTick
fields.comment: +0x26. Set to 1 ONLY when the slot is IDLE (hasUpdate=0, incl. skip-run members) OR is a low-res ADD/promote (GetLowResolutionPlayerPosition returns 1). NOT set for a movement/remove/ext-only high-res record, nor a low-res face/small-move/region-jump. End of handler: nsnFlag=processedThisTick; processedThisTick=0. => idle/added slots become nsnFlag=1 next tick; moved/removed slots nsnFlag=0.

fields.name: nsnFlag
fields.comment: +0x27: NSN (need-second-notify) parity selector = processedThisTick from previous tick. High-res passA processes nsnFlag==0; passB nsnFlag!=0. Low-res passA processes nsnFlag!=0; passB nsnFlag==0.

fields.name: moveSpeed
fields.comment: +0x28: pointer into MoveSpeed::enumArray (&DAT_015bf210). Index 4 (&DAT_015bf220) = instant teleport/warp.

fields.name: graphNodeRef
fields.comment: +0x30: ref_counter_base* shared ref to the rendered scene-graph node (set on promote, DecRef on demote).

fields.name: playerEntity
fields.comment: +0x38: jag::PlayerEntity* — the high-res rendered entity. 0 = slot is low-res only (not rendered). ProcessExtendedInfo reads from here.

fields.name: cachedApprLen
fields.comment: +0x88. Length of the slot-cached appearance/spotanim buffer. On a low-res ADD the client replays THIS buffer (gScrambled*) to build the entity — the appearance is NOT in the GPI bit stream. Populated by a prior ext-info APPEARANCE block.

fields.name: cachedApprPtr
fields.comment: +0x90. Pointer to the slot-cached appearance buffer replayed on low-res ADD. len at +0x88, read-pos at +0x98.

fields.name: flags
fields.comment: Bitfield byte. Bit 0x20 = visible/active flag (set/cleared by Component::SetVisible(bool) at FUN_00216600). Other bits unknown — DO NOT treat as plain mouseHovered bool.

fields.name: xOriginMode
fields.comment: Origin/anchor mode for X. 0=use xOriginOffset directly, 1=center (-w/2), 2=right (-w), 3=zero, 4=center (-w/2), 5=right (-w). Read at +0x32 by FUN_004a93f0 (origin offset helper).

fields.name: yOriginMode
fields.comment: Origin/anchor mode for Y. Same encoding as xOriginMode. Read at +0x33 by FUN_004a93f0.

fields.name: xAnchorMode
fields.comment: Position anchor mode for X. 0=absolute (use rawX), 1=parent-w-minus (-rawX), 2=fraction-of-parent-w (rawX*2^-14). Read at +0x34 by Layer::LayoutChildren (FUN_004bda10).

fields.name: yAnchorMode
fields.comment: Position anchor mode for Y. Same encoding as xAnchorMode. Read at +0x35 by Layer::LayoutChildren.

fields.name: xOriginOffset
fields.comment: Pixel origin offset X (used when xOriginMode==0). Read at +0x38 by FUN_004a93f0.

fields.name: yOriginOffset
fields.comment: Pixel origin offset Y (used when yOriginMode==0). Read at +0x3c by FUN_004a93f0.

fields.name: rawX
fields.comment: Raw X position value (interpreted via xAnchorMode). Read at +0x40 by Layer::LayoutChildren (FUN_004bda10).

fields.name: rawY
fields.comment: Raw Y position value (interpreted via yAnchorMode). Read at +0x44 by Layer::LayoutChildren.

fields.name: parentRelX
fields.comment:
PARENT-LOCAL X offset (NOT screen-absolute). Written by Layer::LayoutChild as: parentInteriorX + originX_int + parentW * originX_frac. Screen-absolute X is computed at draw time by FUN_00428480 (`MOV R13D, [RDI+0x50]; ADD R13D, EBP`) at 0x00428550-0x00428557. Was MISLEADINGLY named 'screenX' previously — corrected.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: parentRelY
fields.comment:
PARENT-LOCAL Y offset (NOT screen-absolute). Written by Layer::LayoutChild as: parentInteriorY + originY_int + parentH * originY_frac. Screen-absolute Y is computed at draw time by FUN_00428480 (`MOV ECX, [RDI+0x54]; ADD ECX, R12D`) at 0x00428554-0x0042855a. Was MISLEADINGLY named 'screenY' previously — corrected.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: screenWidth
fields.comment:
Computed pixel width. Written by Layer::LayoutChild as: parentW * xAnchorFrac + rawX_anchored (xAnchorMode-modulated). For xAnchorMode=1, rawX=0: screenWidth = parentW. Read by ComputeOriginOffset for centering math, by Layer::LayoutChild as parent-W when laying out grandchildren, and by InterfaceManager::CalculateLayerDimensions as fallback if vtable GetScrollWidth returns 0. CONFIRMED valid live (464 px on dialog 1188 component 33). Was previously misnamed 'visibleX'.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: screenHeight
fields.comment:
Computed pixel height. Written by Layer::LayoutChild as: parentH * yAnchorFrac + rawY_anchored (yAnchorMode-modulated). For yAnchorMode=1, rawY=0: screenHeight = parentH. Read by ComputeOriginOffset for centering math, by Layer::LayoutChild as parent-H when laying out grandchildren, and by InterfaceManager::CalculateLayerDimensions as fallback. CONFIRMED valid live (18 px on dialog 1188 component 33). Was previously misnamed 'visibleY'.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: subsystemObserverListStart
fields.comment: Start of vector of subsystem ptrs; each has ChangeMainState at vtable+0x10 (0x193e0)

fields.name: subsystemObserverListEnd
fields.comment: End of vector of subsystem ptrs; iterated in reverse by SetMainState (0x193e8)

fields.name: baseType
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 3: g1 byte -> jag::game::ScriptVarType::GetByID(byte); result stored as an (unresolved) ScriptVarType* here. The var's base value type (INT/LONG/STRING/COORDFINE/etc). Confirmed 948-5 @0x006c3390 vs librs2client.so VarType::DecodeType @0x001b5410 (same opcode number, same call).

fields.name: lifetime
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 4: g1 raw byte, index into jag::game::VarLifetime::enumArray. librs2client.so has named static instances VarLifetime::PERMANENT / TEMPORARY / SERVERPERMANENT (confirmed via .strtab symbols) -- this is the var's persistence/serverperm classification. Exact byte-to-name ordinal mapping NOT independently confirmed in 948-5 (HYPOTHESIS for the specific numeric value, but the FIELD IDENTITY as the lifetime/serverperm classifier is high-confidence).

fields.name: transmitLevel
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 5: g1 raw byte, index into jag::game::VarTransmitLevel::enumArray (librs2client.so confirms at least a NEVER value exists). Likely governs whether/how client-side value changes get transmitted; distinct from `lifetime`. Exact ordinal mapping unconfirmed.

fields.name: field_0x6e_opcode
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 0x6e (110): g2 (Packet::gT<unsigned short>, BE, via inlined helper FUN_0018f870) zero-extended into this dword. HYPOTHESIS ONLY: possibly a clientCode/script-binding id (cf. cc_if_setonvarctransmit-style opcode naming elsewhere in the DB); exact semantic NOT confirmed. Do not treat as settled.

fields.name: flag_opcode7
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 7: NO operand read; unconditionally cleared to 0. Present in both 948-5 (offset 0x50) and the older librs2client.so reference (offset 0x5c there) doing the same unconditional clear -- a stable, long-standing field, not a recent addition. HYPOTHESIS: purpose unconfirmed.

fields.name: flag_opcode8
fields.comment: DecodeType opcode 8: NO operand read; unconditionally set to 1. NOT present at all in the older librs2client.so reference (new opcode in 948-5, analogous to how VarBitType gained opcode 0x10 in a later revision). HYPOTHESIS ONLY -- an interesting but UNCONFIRMED candidate for a serverperm-adjacent marker; do not treat as authoritative.

fields.comment: eastl::string; gStringCP1252ToUTF8 (raw NUL-term CP1252 in un-scrambled buffer)

fields.name: targetPlayerEntity
fields.comment: PlayerEntity the decoded appearance is applied to

fields.name: port1
fields.comment: Primary port (443 for SSL, or computed from worldId)

fields.name: messageCounter
fields.comment: Incrementing counter for chat message IDs

fields.name: hitSlotIndex
fields.comment: Current circular index for hit slots

fields.name: next
fields.comment: next node in hash bucket chain

fields.name: lineRadius
fields.comment: Picking radius for line segment test

fields.name: varBitTypeList
fields.comment: VarBitTypeList ptr. this[0x3d]. Accessed via vtable+0x20 getter and FUN_0070ab90

fields.name: field_0x210
fields.comment: Unknown ptr, returned by vtable+0x38 getter (FUN_0020ed70). this+0x210

fields.name: field_0x2E0
fields.comment: Set post-construction to DAT_0170eff8 pool ptr

fields.name: clientStreamPtr
fields.comment: Pointer to ClientStream (the TCP socket wrapper). Used in TcpIn as `*(int*)(*(long*)(sc+8))` for connection state check (`==2` means connected). Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013d8f4.

fields.name: streamHeartbeat
fields.comment: Stream-activity timer/heartbeat (int) at +0x20. Reset to 0 on each successful Read or after Flush. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013df9f and FlushClientMessages 948-2 @ 0x004eb338 (MOV [param_1+0x24],0).

fields.name: stateByteA
fields.comment: Phase flag byte at +0x28 (cleared by CloseConnection and on opcode-decode error). Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dc1f (MOV [R8+0x28],0).

fields.name: currentOpcode
fields.comment: Opcode currently being decoded at +0x2C (sentinel = 0xffffffff = -1 means 'no opcode yet, waiting for next read'). Set after Isaac decrypt + smart1or2 read in TcpIn. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013e027 (MOV [R15+0x2c],R9D). Engine: OServerConnection.CURRENT_OPCODE.

fields.name: resolvedSize
fields.comment: Resolved payload size at +0x30, after var_byte/var_short header unpack. -1 means we still need the size byte(s); -2 means var_short still pending. Once a positive value, TcpIn reads exactly this many bytes before dispatch. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013e227 (var-byte path), 0x0013e28d (var-short path), 0x0013e34b (fixed from ServerProt). Engine: OServerConnection.RESOLVED_SIZE.

fields.name: hasOpcodeFirstByte
fields.comment: Phase flag at +0x34: 1 = first byte of opcode has been read and resides at bufData[0] (2-byte opcode logic still pending). 0 = no bytes yet for this opcode. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dfae (MOV [R15+0x34],1 after reading the first opcode byte).

fields.name: hasFullPayload
fields.comment: Phase flag at +0x35: 1 = full payload has been read into bufData and is ready for handler dispatch. 0 = still receiving. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013e0cd (MOV [R15+0x35],1 after ClientStream::Read of full payload).

fields.name: handlerYieldCount
fields.comment: Throttle counter at +0x38: incremented every time a ServerProt handler returns code 1 (yield/needs-more-data). When >499 sets overflowFlag at +0x3c. Cleared to 0 on handler success or error. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dc82 (MOV [R8+0x38],R15D) — R15D = R10+1 = previous+1.

fields.name: overflowFlag
fields.comment: Overflow flag at +0x3C: set to 1 when handlerYieldCount exceeds 499. Suppresses further increments. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dc91 (MOV [R8+0x3c],1 when R15D > 0x1f3).

fields.name: msgListHead
fields.comment: Doubly-linked list head sentinel at +0x48 for pending outgoing TcpConnectionMessages. New messages are linked in by Packet::SendClientMessage (0xc2b6e0) at next/prev positions. Drained by FlushClientMessages.

fields.name: msgListTail
fields.comment: Doubly-linked list tail pointer at +0x50 for pending outgoing messages. Verified SendClientMessage 948-2 @ 0x00c2b754 (writes new node-pointer into [net_ctx+0x50]).

fields.name: msgFreeListHead
fields.comment: Free-list head for the in-place node pool (at +0x58). SendClientMessage pops from here, FlushClientMessages pushes here (when the freed node lies inside the pool range).

fields.name: msgAllocEnd
fields.comment: Watermark for the node-pool allocator at +0x60. SendClientMessage tests msgAllocEnd against msgAllocLimit. Bump-allocates when no free node available.

fields.name: msgAllocLimit
fields.comment: Upper bound for node-pool allocation at +0x68. Compared against msgAllocEnd in SendClientMessage.

fields.name: msgAllocStep
fields.comment: Stride at +0x70 for the bump allocator (added to msgAllocEnd after each allocation).

fields.name: msgPoolBase
fields.comment: Lower bound of the in-place node pool at +0x80. FlushClientMessages uses this to decide whether a freed node lives in the pool or on the heap.

fields.name: pendingMessageCount
fields.comment: Number of outgoing messages queued at +0x88. SendClientMessage @ 0x00c2b73c increments; FlushClientMessages decrements as it drains.

fields.name: pendingByteCount
fields.comment: Total bytes pending in the outgoing message queue at +0x2B0. SendClientMessage adds finalPayloadSize when enqueuing; FlushClientMessages subtracts as each message is sent. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x004eb2bc (FlushClientMessages: `[param_1+0x2b0] -= iVar2`).

fields.name: isaacCipher
fields.comment: Pointer to ISAAC cipher state at +0x2B8 (used to decrypt incoming opcode bytes). May be NULL during pre-login phases (raw opcodes). Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013df1b (MOV RBP,[R15+0x2b8]) and again @ 0x0013dfb3, 0x0013dbc6. Engine: OServerConnection.ISAAC_PTR.

fields.name: incomingPacket
fields.comment: Embedded incoming Packet core at +0x2C0 (32 bytes — just header/cap/buf/pos, no cipherBytePtr — the next 0x20 bytes are LAST_OPCODE/sent/recv counters). bufData at +0x2D0 (incomingPacket+0x10), position at +0x2D8 (incomingPacket+0x18). Passed to ServerProt handlers as `lVar16 + 0x2c0` (verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dbd1). Engine: OServerConnection.PACKET_BASE (BUF_DATA=+0x2D0, BUF_POS=+0x2D8).

fields.name: lastOpcode
fields.comment: Most recently successfully-decoded opcode at +0x2E0, preserved for debugging/diagnostics. Stored before clearing currentOpcode on success or error. Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013dc0b (MOV [R8+0x2e0],R9D where R9D was currentOpcode).

fields.name: bytesSentCounter
fields.comment: Lifetime sent-byte counter at +0x2E4. Incremented by FlushClientMessages by each drained message's finalPayloadSize. Verified 948-2 @ 0x004eb2b8.

fields.name: bytesReceivedCounter
fields.comment: Lifetime received-byte counter at +0x2E8. Incremented by TcpIn on every Read (by the number of bytes consumed). Verified TcpIn 948-2 @ 0x0013df97 (ADD [R15+0x2e8],1) and similar.

fields.name: opcode
fields.comment: Packet opcode (copied from ServerProt/ClientProt.opcode at the start of Init). Written by jag::game::TcpConnectionMessage::Init (0x00121f20) at this+0x0 from *param_2.

fields.name: fixedSize
fields.comment: Payload size mode: -1 = var_byte, -2 = var_short, >=0 = fixed byte count. Drives capacity computation in Init.

fields.name: reservedQword
fields.comment: Reserved/padding qword at this+0x8. Not written by Init/InitIncoming. May be 8-byte alignment slot before the cap/buf/pos block. The Packet-write helper FUN_00121f00 takes (packet+0x8) as its first arg and uses offsets +0x10/+0x18 within that sub-view to find bufData/bufWritePos — so this slot acts as a virtual offset shift for the helper.

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: Buffer capacity in bytes (at +0x10). Written by Init via stack-Packet swap (Init at 0x001ab680: MOV [RBX+0x10], RDI where RDI = stack-Packet+0x08 = capacity from Packet::Packet/FUN_00c45d00).

fields.name: bufData
fields.comment: Pointer to raw byte buffer (at +0x18). Written by Init at 0x001ab699 (MOV [RBX+0x18], R9 = stack-Packet+0x10 = bufferPtr from FUN_00c299c0/AllocDispatch). NOTE: This is the OUTBOUND layout — for the incoming/standalone Packet (PacketCore, used at SC+0x2C0), bufferPtr is at +0x10 from packet base.

fields.name: bufWritePos
fields.comment: Running write position at +0x20 (post-incremented on every p* writer). On the outgoing Packet, this is the bytes-written count. Init writes 0; SendClientMessage reads it and copies to finalPayloadSize, then zeroes it.

fields.name: finalPayloadSize
fields.comment: Final payload size in bytes at +0x28. Set by SendClientMessage when enqueuing (copied from bufWritePos). Read by FlushClientMessages for byte-count tracking.

fields.name: protPtr
fields.comment: Pointer back to the ServerProt or ClientProt struct for this packet's opcode (at +0x30). Written by Init at the line `*(void **)(packet + 1) = protPtr;` (Init writes packet[1] when Packet is interpreted as an array — effectively packet+sizeof(Packet)=packet+0x30).

fields.name: varTypeRefBlock
fields.comment: Shared_ptr ref block for parent VarType (opcode 1). 0x38

fields.name: defaultValue
fields.comment: Default value (EASTL variant - int at +0x48 opcode 4, string at +0x68 opcode 3). 0x48

fields.name: sizedArrayData
fields.comment: Sized array data ptr (0x20-byte entries: key + value). 0xC8

fields.name: secondaryHashBuckets
fields.comment: Secondary EASTL hash_map bucket array ptr (reverse lookup). 0xE0

fields.name: models2Data
fields.comment: Models2 data ptr (int array, model IDs). 0x218

fields.name: models2AltCount
fields.comment: Models2 alt array count (opcode 102). 0x240. Stores model variant/skin IDs.

fields.name: modelsData
fields.comment: Models data ptr (int array, model IDs via gSmart2or4). 0x2D8

fields.name: resizeZ
fields.comment: Resize Z scale (opcode 97/0x61, set same as X). 0x3AC

fields.name: sceneKey
fields.comment: World/scene unique id (g4 BE in op199; middle-endian in WORLDENTITY_ADD). Upsert key into WorldList. Also used as list index by REBUILD_WORLDENTITY.

fields.name: destKeys_begin
fields.comment: eastl::vector<uint> begin. Destination region/area keys (g4 BE) for this world's build-area squares.

fields.name: srcKeys_begin
fields.comment: eastl::vector<uint> begin. Source region/area keys (g4 BE). Empty (count 0) = STATIC world (no composite copy).

fields.name: srcKeys_end
fields.comment: srcKeys vector end. count = (end-begin)/4 = srcCount = matrix row count.

fields.name: levels_begin
fields.comment: eastl::vector<int> begin. Per-src source plane/level (g1 signed). Pre-filled with -1, then set per src row.

fields.name: levels_end
fields.comment: levels vector end (one int per src).

fields.name: matrix_begin
fields.comment: eastl::vector<eastl::vector<uint>> begin. matrix[srcRow][destCol] = packed src-chunk descriptor (plane<<24|chunkX<<14|chunkY<<3|rot<<1) or 0x80000000 (no source). Each sub-vector is 0x18 bytes.

fields.name: matrix_end
fields.comment: matrix vector end (one sub-vector per src row).

fields.name: actionsArray
fields.comment: Pointer to actions array (5+5 entries, 0x40 bytes each). 0x30

fields.name: modelIdsCount
fields.comment: Model IDs array of arrays count (opcode 1). 0x248

fields.name: modelIdsData
fields.comment: Model IDs data ptr (array of sub-arrays, 0x18-byte entries). 0x258

fields.name: animIdsData
fields.comment: Animation IDs data ptr (8-byte entries: id+weight). 0x370

fields.name: transformIdsData
fields.comment: Transform IDs array data ptr (int array). 0x3C0

fields.name: visibleType
fields.comment: Visible location type ptr (used by GetPickabilityFlag at this+0xC8)

fields.name: renderNodeCtrl
fields.comment: shared_ptr control block for render node (0x268). Checked by shared_ptr validator before accessing renderNode.

fields.name: renderNode
fields.comment: Render node data ptr (0x270). Same layout as ORenderModel: world transform at +0x30, mesh components at +0x288. Used when parentCombinedLocation is null.

fields.name: parentCombinedLocation
fields.comment: Parent CombinedLocation ptr (0x330). When non-null, PickTest uses parent's render model at parent+0x958 instead of this entity's renderNode.

fields.name: lastMoveSpeed
fields.comment: Pointer to last move speed uint32 (OPathingEntity.LAST_MOVESPEED = 0x98)

fields.name: nextXOffsetFine
fields.comment: Next movement X offset in fine coords (OPathingEntity.NEXT_X_OFFSET_FINE = 0xA0)

fields.name: nextYOffsetFine
fields.comment: Next movement Y offset in fine coords (OPathingEntity.NEXT_Y_OFFSET_FINE = 0xA8)

fields.name: interactingNpcSid
fields.comment: Server index of NPC this entity interacts with (OPathingEntity.INTERACTING_NPC_SID = 0x1B4)

fields.name: isVisible
fields.comment: Visibility flag from VisibilityFlag ext info (bit 29). 0xD95

fields.name: bodyTypeId
fields.comment: Body/model type override ID from ModelOverride ext info (bit 14). 0x10D0

fields.name: booleanFlagValue
fields.comment: Boolean flag value from BooleanFlag ext info (bit 33). 0x1160

fields.name: hiddenMenuOpFlags
fields.comment: Bitfield controlling which right-click options are hidden (ONPC.HIDDEN_MENUOP_FLAGS = 0x115C)

fields.name: refCount
fields.comment: shared_ptr ref count. Init: 0x100000001 = strong=1, weak=1. Low 32 bits = strong, high 32 = weak.

fields.name: selfPtr
fields.comment: Points to self (this message) for shared_ptr tracking

fields.name: packetPtr
fields.comment: Pointer to the embedded Packet at +0x20 (always points to this+0x20)

fields.name: reservedQword
fields.comment: 8 bytes of reserved/padding inside the embedded Packet (at Packet+0x08). Never written by FUN_00121f20 (outgoing init) or FUN_001ab5e0 (incoming init). Likely alignment for the cap/buf/pos triple that follows. Was incorrectly labeled 'bufRefCount' in the 947-3 era.

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: Buffer capacity in bytes. Embedded Packet's +0x08 (capacity field). Initialised by Packet::Packet from FUN_00121f20/001ab5e0 with size derived from fixedSize mode: -1=0x14, -2=0x2710, fixed<=0x12=0x14, fixed=0x13..0x62=0x62, else 0x104. Verified by 948-2 disasm at 0x001ab680 (MOV [RBX+0x10],RDI where RDI=stack-Packet+0x08=capacity).

fields.name: bufData
fields.comment: Pointer to raw payload byte buffer (Packet+0x10 within embedded Packet). Verified 948-2 disasm at 0x001ab699 (MOV [RBX+0x18],R9 where R9=stack-Packet+0x10=bufferPtr from Packet::Packet/FUN_00c45d00). Engine SendClientMessage hook reads this at objectPtr+0x18 (objectPtr=msg+0x20 → +0x38 absolute) — engine offset is correct, Ghidra struct field was misnamed.

fields.name: bufWritePos
fields.comment: Running write position in buffer (bytes written so far including opcode/size header). Embedded Packet's +0x18 (the standard 'position' cursor used by all jag::Packet::p* writers and g* readers — but on outgoing TcpConnectionMessage this is the bytes-written count). SendClientMessage (0xc2b6e0 in 948-2) reads this at lVar1+0x20 (lVar1=msg+0x20), copies to finalPayloadSize, then zeros it.

fields.name: finalPayloadSize
fields.comment: Final payload size in bytes. Set by SendClientMessage when enqueuing (copied from bufWritePos). Used by FlushClientMessages for byte count tracking.

fields.name: protPtr
fields.comment: Pointer back to the ServerProt or ClientProt struct for this packet's opcode

fields.name: sourceLevel
fields.comment: Source level/plane index (0-3); -1 = empty/invalid zone. In region decode: extracted from bits 24-25 of packed zone data.

fields.name: zoneX
fields.comment: Zone X coordinate (in zone units, i.e. tile/8)

fields.name: zoneY
fields.comment: Zone Y coordinate (in zone units, i.e. tile/8)

fields.name: regionIndex
fields.comment: Index into ClientCompositeData.regionCoords vector; maps zone to source region (regionX, regionY)

fields.name: inventoryVectorBegin
fields.comment: Vector begin of inventory entries (sorted by key)

fields.name: rowsBegin
fields.comment: fixed_vector begin - points to +0x28 (inline CompositeRow buffer). Each row is 0xA8 bytes.

fields.name: rowsEnd
fields.comment: fixed_vector end - advances by 0xA8 per row. Max 8 rows inline = +0x568.

fields.name: rowsCapacity
fields.comment: fixed_vector capacity - points to this+0x568 (end of inline buffer for 8 rows).

fields.name: rowsPool
fields.comment: fixed_vector_allocator mPool - points to +0x28 (inline buffer start).

fields.name: zonesBegin
fields.comment: fixed_vector begin - points to +0x28 (inline shared_ptr buffer). Each entry is 0x10 bytes: {data_ptr, refcount_ptr}.

fields.name: zonesEnd
fields.comment: fixed_vector end - advances by 0x10 per zone shared_ptr added. Max 8 zones inline = +0xA8.

fields.name: zonesCapacity
fields.comment: fixed_vector capacity - points to this+0xA8 (end of inline buffer for 8 entries).

fields.name: zonesPool
fields.comment: fixed_vector_allocator mPool - points to +0x28 (inline buffer start). If overflow, begin != pool.

fields.name: staticLocationTreeLeft
fields.comment: RB tree sentinel — left child pointer. Tree contains the static (cache-loaded) Location/CombinedLocation entries. Iterated via jag::rbtree::next (FUN_00aa5940). LOC_DEL walks this tree at the top of its loop.

fields.name: staticLocationTreeRight
fields.comment: RB tree sentinel — right child pointer (== begin of iteration for rbtree::next).

fields.name: dynamicLocationsBegin
fields.comment: VERIFIED 948-2: eastl::vector<shared_ptr<MapSquareLocation>>::begin. Each entry is 16 bytes: {qword ctrl @ +0, qword ptr @ +8}. Written by LocationContainer::Add (FUN_00135ed0) and read by LOC_DEL collision matcher. THIS IS THE WRITER-SIDE TRUTH — replaces the previous-agent's wrong claim of "11 fixed slots at +0x40..+0x220 stride 0x30".

fields.name: dynamicLocationsEnd
fields.comment: VERIFIED 948-2: vector<shared_ptr<MapSquareLocation>>::end. (end - begin) / 16 = count of dynamic locations.

fields.name: dynamicLocationsCap
fields.comment: VERIFIED 948-2: vector<shared_ptr<MapSquareLocation>>::capacity_end. When end == cap_end, vector reallocates via FUN_00135ae0 (DoInsertValue).

fields.name: multiLocationsBegin
fields.comment:
LC+0xB0: vector BEGIN of {ctrl,ptr} entries (16-byte stride). Each entry points to a Location-like object with fields at +0x40 (mapsquareX), +0x16c (X), +0x170 (Y), +0x18d (isHidden), +0x194 (flag), +0xc8 (ptr). Iterated by UPDATE_ZONE_FULL_FOLLOWS @ 0x000f855e..0x000f8579 with stride 0x10.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: multiLocationsEnd
fields.comment:
LC+0xB8: vector END. (end - begin) / 16 = count of multi-tile locations.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: primaryLocationsBegin
fields.comment:
LC+0xC8: vector BEGIN of {ctrl,ptr} entries (16-byte stride). Each entry points to a Location object with fields at +0x40 (mapsquareX), +0x16c (X), +0x170 (Y), +0x18d (isHidden), +0x194 (flag), +0xc8 (some ptr). Iterated by UPDATE_ZONE_FULL_FOLLOWS @ 0x000f8164..0x000f81e3 — this is the PRIMARY scene-object vector for cache-loaded locations.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: primaryLocationsEnd
fields.comment:
LC+0xD0: vector END. (end - begin) / 16 = count of primary locations.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: tertiaryLocationsBegin
fields.comment:
LC+0xE0: vector BEGIN of {ctrl,ptr} entries (16-byte stride). Third vector of locations (perhaps cross-tile or special category). Iterated by UPDATE_ZONE_FULL_FOLLOWS @ 0x000f81e3..0x000f855e.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: tertiaryLocationsEnd
fields.comment:
LC+0xE8: vector END for tertiary locations.</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: dispatchTableArrayStart
fields.comment:
LC+0xF8: START of an array of 5 sub-slots × 0x48 bytes each (LC+0xF8, +0x140, +0x188, +0x1D0, +0x218). Indexed via byte at DAT_01391630 (5-byte dispatch table). Each sub-slot has its own vector triple: subSlot+0x28 = vec.begin, subSlot+0x30 = vec.end (stride 0x10). Entries point to "section" objects with nested vec at section+0xA0..+0xA8 (stride 0xC0). Iterated by UPDATE_ZONE_FULL_FOLLOWS @ 0x000f88d6..end and FUN_0063d630 (renderer).</comment>
</invoke>

fields.name: graphNode
fields.comment: jag::graphics::GraphNode* (created+AddChild in hub FUN_0016b500). Entity base field.

fields.name: entityType
fields.comment: Entity+0x10. = 0xd (13 = HINT_ARROW). Written by hub ctor.

fields.name: pickType
fields.comment: Entity+0x11 pickType (=6). +0x12 is a paired pickType byte (=6).

fields.name: entityPlane
fields.comment: Entity+0x40 plane/level. Written from plVar49[3] or scene node level in hub ctor.

fields.name: entitySharedPtr_ctrl
fields.comment: Entity base shared_ptr control block @ +0x48 (value @ +0x50). DecRef'd in dtor (param_1[9]).

fields.name: targetPosX
fields.comment: +0x70 target world X. Engine OHintArrow.TARGET_POS_VEC3=0x70. 16-byte aligned vector written from plVar49[3..] in hub ctor.

fields.name: targetPosY
fields.comment: +0x74 target world Y (engine reads x@+0x70, y@+0x74).

fields.name: targetPosZ
fields.comment: +0x78 target world Z (third lane of the 16-byte target-pos vector).

fields.name: targetEntitySharedPtr_ctrl
fields.comment: +0x88 shared_ptr control block to the targeted Entity (NPC/Player/Loc). Engine OHintArrow.TARGET_ENTITY_SHARED_PTR=0x88. Zeroed in ctor (puVar25[0x11]=0). DecRef'd in dtor.

fields.name: targetEntitySharedPtr_value
fields.comment: +0x90 shared_ptr value (Entity*) of the targeted entity. Zeroed in ctor (puVar25[0x12]=0). Engine reads the value at +0x90.

fields.name: lockonServerIndex
fields.comment: Server index of lock-on target entity (OProjectile.LOCKON_SERVER_INDEX = 0x70)

fields.name: headModelsData
fields.comment: Head models array data ptr (6 ints). 0x1A0

fields.name: groundCursorsData
fields.comment: Ground cursors array data ptr (5 ints). 0x1B8

fields.name: price
fields.comment: Item price (opcode 12 as int, opcode 181 as long). 0x1E0

fields.name: tradeable2
fields.comment: Second tradeable flag (opcode 15 sets to false). 0x220

fields.name: offsetX
fields.comment: Interface model offset X (opcode 7, signed short). 0x2B0

fields.name: offsetY
fields.comment: Interface model offset Y (opcode 8, signed short). 0x2B4

fields.name: renderNodeControlBlock
fields.comment: shared_ptr control block for render node (Entity+0x58)

fields.name: renderNode
fields.comment: Render node object ptr (Entity+0x60). Same layout as RenderModel: transform@+0x30, meshComponents@+0x288

fields.name: originalType
fields.comment: Pointer to original LocType before transforms (OLocation.ORIGINAL_TYPE = 0xD8)

fields.name: parent
fields.comment: Parent GraphNode pointer at +0x130. Set by GraphNode::AddChild (0x006ebb40): line `*(long *)(param_2 + 0x130) = param_1`. NOT in engine OGraphNode but verified in 948-2.

fields.name: childrenInlineBufferPtr
fields.comment: Pointer to inline children buffer (at +0x160). Used as "do not free this" marker in AddChild. Initialized to +0x160 in ctor (LEA R10, [RDI + 0x160] then MOV [RDI+0x158], R10). Verified in 948-2.

fields.name: minX
fields.comment: AABB stored in {X, Z, Y} memory order matching scene position

fields.name: minZ
fields.comment: Height axis, raw component 1 (memory order: X, Z, Y)

fields.name: minY
fields.comment: Depth axis, raw component 2 (memory order: X, Z, Y)

fields.name: minW
fields.comment: SSE padding (unused 4th component of min vector)

fields.name: maxZ
fields.comment: Height axis, raw component 1 (memory order: X, Z, Y)

fields.name: maxY
fields.comment: Depth axis, raw component 2 (memory order: X, Z, Y)
